reviewed_by: Claude: Claude harness advertises and sends reasoning effort
reason: Prod refused every Butler goal on the Claude harness with 422 "reasoning effort 'high' is not advertised for 'claude-opus-5-5'": the Claude probe listed models but no model_options, so create_session's effort check had an empty allowed set, and the adapter never passed an effort to the SDK anyway. The probe now lists the SDK's EffortLevel values (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) for every advertised model with no default, and ClaudeAgentSdkAdapter.open passes the session's runtime_options reasoning_effort as ClaudeAgentOptions.effort. Python selects the harness adapter, harness runtime, Claude harness, harness goal, goal routing, Butler capabilities and harness leftovers suites, which cover the probe, session creation, goal creation and Butler routing over harness model options.
exclusions: No UI change: Settings and Butler already render efforts from model_options generically, so frontend and Playwright suites are not selected. No setting is added or renamed, so the settings catalog, settings-assistant doc and product knowledge index are unchanged. No default effort is set, so existing Claude sessions keep the CLI default and are not recreated. Native code is untouched. Three selected tests already fail on origin/main 0a59618 (test_harnesses.py::test_knowledge_access_change_refreshes_fixed_gateway_catalog, test_harnesses.py::test_browser_attachment_refreshes_catalog_without_replacing_native_thread, test_butler_capabilities.py::test_scheduled_butler_can_edit_all_assistant_settings) and are unrelated to this change.
